# Unleaf

> Unleaf is a free online LaTeX editor with no login, command autocomplete, live preview, browser-local drafts, and PDF export.

## Pages
- [Editor](https://www.unleaf.lol/): Write and preview a LaTeX document in the browser.
- [Guide](https://www.unleaf.lol/guide): Getting started, commands, keyboard shortcuts, export instructions, storage behavior, and limitations.
- [Sitemap](https://www.unleaf.lol/sitemap.xml): Public canonical URLs.

## Product facts
- Drafts are stored locally in the browser, not synced across devices.
- The preview uses a browser-based renderer, not a full TeX compiler.
- Arbitrary packages and advanced document classes are not fully supported.
- PDF export opens the browser print dialog.
- Unleaf is independent and is not affiliated with Overleaf.
